rescaled.where: event mltd.51 option a (Act V trophy, 'Strike off the collars'), via new scripted effect mltd_legion_pens_freed
rescaled.was: +5,000 population in the capital (OWB add_state_population) and +5 % stability, one-off
rescaled.now: permanent idea mltd_the_unchained: stability_factor +0.05 (replaces the old one-off +5 % one for one) and compliance_growth +0.10
rescaled.why: The event fires at about 2284-03, between the plan's 2282-05 snapshot (1.3-1.7M people, ~60 mil) and its 2285-12 snapshot (3-4M, ~110 mil), so MLT has about 2.5M people. 5,000 people is 0.2 % of that, which is noise. Compliance growth is OWB's conqueror lever: coring needs 95 % compliance, and by 2285 MLT is coring 300-400 states. So the modifier scales with the land MLT holds. 0.10 is inside OWB's own range (0.04-0.20) and matches mltd_the_drowned_harvest. Both modifiers stay inside the story acts' +-5-10 % band.

rescaled.where: event mltd.51 option b ('The spawning pools are hungry'), via new scripted effect mltd_legion_pens_fed
rescaled.was: +5,000 manpower, one-off
rescaled.now: timed idea mltd_the_pens_emptied for 365 days: build_cost_ic -0.20 on amphibious_beast_equipment, mltd_deep_ones_equipment and mltd_star_spawn_equipment, keyed by archetype as continuous_mltd_spawning_pools is. It stacks with that idea's -15 %.
rescaled.why: Manpower is not MLT's bottleneck, and 5,000 is noise at about 2.5M people. By Act V MLT fields creatures: the plan turns its levies into Tide Walls once the NCR is beaten. At about 85 military factories (interpolated for 2284) on OWB's 5 IC a day and 50-70 % efficiency, a year's output is about 78,000-108,000 IC. A fifth off the creatures' price makes that about 20,000-27,000 IC more of them: 1,000-1,350 mirelurks, or five to seven Tide Walls. The idea grows with whatever industry it lands in, so it roughly matches the value of the permanent option a. The AI's weights stay a 2 : b 1.

rescaled.was: 4 infantry_equipment + 1 support_equipment per point of total cult strength, for the whole game

rescaled.why: This is the user's Legion's Armouries complaint in decision form: from Act V the tribe no longer fields rifles. The plan converts its Shell Levies and Coral Hosts into all-mirelurk templates once the NCR is beaten, and so does the AI's mltd_ai_late_army. A point was worth 4 rifles at 2-3.5 IC and a support crate at 5 IC, about 13-19 IC. One mirelurk is 15-20 IC (cre_amphibious_eq.txt), so the call keeps its value and changes only what it pays in. It still scales with the cults the player keeps up.
